the panel reveal is a CSS view timeline; without support or with reduced motion it simply shows

items.title: Column
items.description: A cool near-white bank page: deep navy ink for headings and the filled CTA, grey-blue body text, white buttons on hairline rings and #eeeff2 tiles, 8px corners and whisper-quiet depth. Each section gets a small accent (teal-green, blue, lime, orange, purple, crimson). Dark sibling: the deep teal band from the middle of the page, with pale cyan and mint for emphasis.

Host Grotesk stands in for Suisse Int'l (closed); Source Code Pro for Suisse Int'l Mono and SF Mono

items.title: Daq backdrop
items.description: A fixed, window-filling media layer behind the whole page (the original's liquid WebGL), overlaid with a faint 12-column hairline grid and a vignette into the page colour at the bottom. Transparent sections show it; solid ones cover it, so it appears and disappears as you scroll.
notes: place it first on the page; give the sections after it position: relative (all daq blocks are) so they paint above it
the media slot fills the window like object-fit cover; empty, it is a blue-grey muted surface with a soft glow wash
best on dark themes

items.title: Daq capabilities
items.description: A two-weight uppercase heading over a row of large square-cornered service cards (number, monospace tech tags, a big title, a short line, an 'explore' link and a huge hairline-thin index numeral). On desktop the section pins for four windows of scroll while the card row slides left, a progress line fills under it, the current tab lights and each card's title fills with white from left to right as it arrives. On phones the cards stack and each title fills as its card scrolls in.
notes: all motion is CSS scroll-driven (no JavaScript); without support the cards sit in a row you can't slide on desktop, so keep to five or fewer there

the original's charcoal pages (careers, privacy) are the dark scope plus bg-card

A picker list of layouts (each with a small icon and a FREE or PLUS tag; the chosen one sits on a lighter pill) drives a wide card beside it: a preview slot, the layout's name, a line and a dotted list, which swap in with a quick fade and rise. Below: a tall stat card with a huge paper-to-mint numeral, a wide card of colour-theme chips, three small mint-eyebrow cards and an underlined link. Cards rise and un-blur into view in turn.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); the preview is a slot per layout, a placeholder when empty
theme swatches take token names ("primary", "chart-3"…) so they follow the page's theme
needs JavaScript for the picker (hydrate: visible); without it the first layout shows

items.title: Plumeform pricing plans (v2)

The paid plan glows deep teal with paper text: a paper monthly/yearly pill toggle beside the price, a line, a paper pill CTA, a small note, paper ticks and a footnote. Above them an eyebrow and heavy heading (a page title or a section title with a link at the right). Cards rise and un-blur into view.

items.description: A full-window photo hero that pins in place while the next section slides up over it. items.title: Wild AG
items.description: Warm paper-white and a pinker light surface, espresso ink and warm-grey text, with a taupe-to-sand brand gradient for bands, card panels and titles. Inter for running text and labels, Inria Serif italic for uppercase section titles; 16px corners, pills everywhere else, flat.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in deep espresso with the same taupe and sand
primary is the taupe (gradient start), highlight the sand (gradient end): blocks paint the brand gradient as from-primary to-highlight
muted/card is the pinker light surface of whole bands and raised tiles; secondary is the sand used for media placeholders
border is the taupe at 25%, the colour of every hairline and pill outline
radius 16px; the bands' big bottom radius is computed from it (x3.4 on phones, x4.5 from 1024px)
gutter 18px on phones, 48px from 768px, 80px from 1024px; --page-width is the 1160px content column inside the gutters
